messages:
Noah Rivera: Hi all — Noah here, joining as Product Designer on the onboarding squad. First-day asks: need Figma access, link to the onboarding roadmap, and where research synths live. Also wondering if there's a short intro checklist for new designers.
Priya (DesignOps): Welcome Noah! :wave: What's your signup email? I'll add you to the Design team and share the onboarding file list.
Noah Rivera: noah.rivera@redwood.com — thanks.
Evan_IT: Okta should have provisioned you. If Figma invite doesn't show, go to https://okta.redwood.com/apps -> Request Access -> Figma. DM me if it hangs.
Priya (DesignOps): Sent Figma invite and added you to "Design / Onboarding" team. Canonical component library: Team > Redwood DS > Onboarding Components. Also added you to #design-review.
Zoe (Research): Research artifacts: raw recordings in Dovetail; synthesized notes and highlights in Notion under Research / Syntheses / Onboarding. We prefer a 3-bullet TL;DR on each synth.
Hector_PM: Roadmap: Product / Roadmap / Onboarding initiative (6-month view). There's a short initiative brief at the top with KPIs. I can do a 20m overview today at 4pm if that works.
Noah Rivera: 4pm works, appreciate it. Is there a preferred flow for updating components that affect signup?
Priya (DesignOps): Use the Onboarding Components library for shared updates. Create a RFC in the Product Spec DB, attach the Figma file and ping eng-review. If it's a tokens change, loop in Maya from DS.
Evan_IT: Quick helper: if invite email got filtered, try the Slack slash command: ``/request-app figma noah.rivera@redwood.com`` — that triggers a resend.
welcome-bot: Automated: added Noah Rivera to "Design / Onboarding" Figma team and granted Notion read access (pending acceptance).
Noah Rivera: Got the Figma invite and opened the component library. Thanks everyone — I'll read the roadmap and join the 4pm sync. Happy to pair on the first usability test writeup.
